primitives.name: Data Freshness Monitor
primitives.verbatim_quote: using in production --## User Value - Pick content is backed by reliable, current API data that refreshes on schedule.
primitives.assumptions: Data is timestamped and refreshed at fixed intervals; staleness exceeds threshold implies degradation.

layer2.mapping: Time-based freshness validation kernel derived from last successful call and scheduled refresh.
layer2.telemetry: Last update timestamp and refresh interval observed in Operator Cockpit.

primitives.name: API Key Security Policy
primitives.verbatim_quote: --## Section 3 — API Key Security ### Rule AK-1: Keys Never in Code All API keys must be stored as environment variables.
primitives.assumptions: Keys are isolated per environment; no plaintext exposure in logs or prompts.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If key appears in committed file, log, or prompt

layer2.mapping: Key management isomorphic to secure credential abstraction layer across environments.
layer2.telemetry: Key usage audit logs and environment segregation checks.
